title: 군무원 특별채용 등에 관한 특례규정 / queue:ADDENDUM:19283:20060126:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM <No. 19283, January 26, 2006>
(1) (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
(2) (Transitional Measure concerning Career Evaluation) In applying Article 6 (1) until December 31, 2006, "Article 26 (2) of the Regulations on Performance Evaluation, etc. of Public Officials" shall be deemed "Article 14 (2) and attached Table 1 of the Regulations on Rating of Public Officials (meaning the Regulations before wholly amended as the Regulations on Performance Evaluation, etc. of Public Officials by Presidential Decree No. 19187 on December 26, 2005)."
